about.title: Who am I?
about.paragraph1: Trained in Germany over twenty years ago, I have always experienced naturopathy as an art of awakening and harmonizing the vital forces of body, mind, and soul. Over the years, my practice has opened to vibratory care, meditation, and an inner approach to healing where each gesture becomes a space of listening, presence, and rebalancing. I accompany each person at their own pace to rediscover inner harmony, clarity of heart, and vitality of being.
about.paragraph2: My practice also includes a meditation space where I welcome small groups for guided practices and moments of reconnection with oneself, to nourish inner life and support energetic and emotional blossoming.
about.paragraph3: I accompany you to find a guiding thread, a solid and harmonious inner path.

diplomas.question: Naturopath Diploma
diplomas.answer: Naturopath Diploma (Heilpraktikerin) in 2003 at the Arche Medica Academy of Naturopathy in Berlin with "Authorization to Practice" issued after official examinations by the Berlin-Spandau Medical Chamber.

diplomas.question: Training at ArcheMedica Berlin Academy
diplomas.answer: Graduated from the ArcheMedica Berlin Academy in Acupuncture, Acupressure, Moxibustion, Auricular therapy, Reflexology, Flower Essences, Amma Massage, Homeopathy, 1999-2004

diplomas.question: Shamanic Drum
diplomas.answer: Trained in Shamanic Drum practice at the International Institute of Shamanic Practices founded by ethnologist and writer Michael Harner, Austria, 2001

diplomas.question: Reiki
diplomas.answer: Reiki, Master and Teacher Degree, 2002-2003, trained by Master Teacher and Healer Anna-Tara Dahm under the auspices of the International Reiki Organization in Düsseldorf.

diplomas.question: Feng Shui
diplomas.answer: Energetic Feng Shui for body and places at Licht Zentrum, Energy Therapy Center in Ribeauvillé according to the method developed by Franck Eickermann, as well as Alpha Chi Consultant and Fire Shamanism, 2014

diplomas.question: Chromobioenergy
diplomas.answer: Chromobioenergy, cellular vibratory therapy through colors according to the method developed by Evelyne Monsallier, 2019-2020.

sessions.question: How long does a session last?
sessions.answer: A session generally lasts between 60 and 90 minutes and may vary according to your needs and current state.

sessions.question: How does the first contact and appointment booking work?
sessions.answer: The first contact is made by phone, free of charge via the website, to clarify your expectations and determine the best way to support you. You can also write to me at contact@coeurdelom.fr with your contact details, date of birth and availability so that I can contact you quickly and schedule an appointment.

sessions.question: How does an energy or holistic treatment session proceed?
sessions.answer: The session begins with a discussion about your condition and needs. You settle in comfortably dressed and I work on your energy with different techniques such as Reiki, crystals, crystal tuning forks, acupressure or chromobioenergy. The goal is to restore harmony and energy circulation while listening to your sensations.

sessions.question: Do I need to undress for a session?
sessions.answer: No, you remain dressed and it is recommended to wear comfortable clothing to be at ease.

sessions.question: What is energy work?
sessions.answer: Energy work aims to balance and harmonize the body's energy flows to support physical, emotional and mental healing. It complements naturopathy by considering body, mind and soul as a whole and helps release blockages, stimulate vitality and strengthen overall well-being.

sessions.question: What is holistic therapy?
sessions.answer: Holistic therapy considers the person as a whole and focuses on identifying and treating the root causes of imbalances. It uses natural methods such as meditation, chromobioenergy, vibratory sounds, aromatherapy or body techniques to restore harmony, promote self-healing and strengthen energetic and emotional balance.

sessions.question: Who can benefit from these sessions?
sessions.answer: Anyone wishing to harmonize their energy, reduce stress, improve their vitality, regain serenity and inner balance can benefit from these approaches.

sessions.question: Do these treatments replace traditional medicine?
sessions.answer: No, they complement conventional medical treatments and do not replace them, offering natural and energetic support to optimize health and well-being.

sessions.question: Where does the session take place?
sessions.answer: Sessions take place at the Montpellier office, Beaux-Arts district, in a secure and restorative space, conducive to relaxation and energetic harmonization.

tcm.question: What is my background in Traditional Chinese Medicine?
tcm.answer: I am a Heilpraktiker, a recognized natural health practitioner in Germany, trained in Traditional Chinese Medicine and acupuncture, and my years of practice have allowed me to acquire in-depth knowledge of meridians, acupuncture points and fundamental energy principles of TCM

tcm.question: What techniques have I practiced?
tcm.answer: I practiced acupuncture as part of my comprehensive training in Germany, but today I use it in a restricted manner according to French legislation, while auricular therapy, moxibustion and acupressure on meridian points are authorized for me.

tcm.question: How does this knowledge contribute to my energy treatments?
tcm.answer: Although French legislation prohibits the practice of acupuncture by non-physicians, this knowledge constitutes a valuable asset for energetic anamnesis and allows me to understand a client's energy profile with precision, identify key meridian points that can be stimulated through acupressure, and use tools such as the styletto, colors, bowls and crystal tuning forks by targeting specific points to amplify energy circulation

tcm.question: What does this combination of techniques bring to my clients?
tcm.answer: This combination of techniques offers my clients a complete and personalized energetic approach, promotes harmonization of energy flows according to their constitution and needs, and frames my other energy therapies ensuring coherence and safety

blog.title: Blog
blog.subtitle: In this space, I share short articles designed as gentle reflections – soft invitations to meditation and introspection. You will also find references to inspiring books and authors, offered freely so that everyone may follow their own inner calling. These simple yet meaningful texts accompany your personal journey and naturally align with the practices offered at Cœur de l'OM.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to the most common questions about our treatments and practices.

questions.question: What is ChromoBioEnergy?
questions.answer: ChromoBioEnergy is a therapeutic method that uses colors and their vibrational frequencies to harmonize body and mind. Developed by Evelyne Monsallier, it allows the detection and correction of energetic imbalances through chromoemotional tests.

questions.question: How does a Reiki session work?
questions.answer: A Reiki session typically lasts between 60 and 90 minutes. You lie down, clothed, in a calm environment. The practitioner places their hands on or above different parts of your body to channel universal energy. The session promotes deep relaxation and the release of energy blockages.

questions.question: Are vibratory treatments compatible with medical treatment?
questions.answer: Yes, vibratory treatments are complementary and do not replace medical treatment. They can be practiced alongside conventional medicine to support the body's natural healing process.

questions.question: Is special preparation required before a session?
questions.answer: It is recommended to wear comfortable clothing and avoid heavy meals just before the session. Come with an open and available mind to receive healing energies.

questions.question: How many sessions are needed?
questions.answer: The number of sessions varies according to individual needs and desired goals. Some people feel benefits from the first session, while others prefer support over several weeks. We discuss together the best program for you.

questions.question: Do you offer group sessions for meditation?
questions.answer: Yes, my practice includes a meditation space where I occasionally welcome small groups for guided practices and experiences of reconnection with oneself.

why.title: Why Cœur de l'Om?
why.description:
The name « Cœur de l'OM » brings together several layers of meaning and resonance. « Cœur » (Heart) refers to the inner center, the seat of energy, intuition and consciousness, where the soul and inner vibration can fully express themselves. It is the place of balance, harmony and the meeting point between body, mind and vital energy.

« OM » evokes the primordial vibration of the universe, present in Indian and Buddhist traditions, a symbol of unity and the circulation of cosmic energy. It is the original sound that connects humans to the universe and to their own intuitive vibration, fostering coherence and inner harmony.

The name also plays with « Cœur de l'Homme » (Heart of Man), emphasizing that all energetic and spiritual work begins with the opening of the human heart, where compassion, intuition, love and awakening meet.

From an esoteric perspective, the soul expresses itself through the vibration of energy, and the heart is the center of the connection between the individual and universal life. Thus, « Cœur de l'OM » is not just a name, but a call to inner resonance, to intuition and to conscious presence – a place where one reconnects with their own light, their inner guidance and that of the universe.

therapies.title: My Therapies
therapies.subtitle: Discover the different therapeutic approaches I offer for your well-being and energetic harmonization.

reiki.title: Reiki
reiki.description: Reiki is a Japanese energy therapy that uses Universal Life Energy to promote physical, emotional, mental and spiritual healing. The practitioner places their hands on or above the body to channel this energy, eliminate blockages and restore harmony, while also working on the position and balance of the chakras to harmonize the overall energetic flow. Accessible to all, not linked to any religion, this non-invasive and safe practice helps reduce stress, relieve pain, improve sleep and support emotional balance while complementing conventional medical treatments.

reiki.question: What is Reiki?
reiki.answer: Reiki is a Japanese energy practice rediscovered in the early 20th century by Mikao Usui after a profound meditative experience on Mount Kurama. The term Reiki means 'Universal Life Energy' (Rei = universal, Ki = vital energy). This method aims to restore harmony, support energy circulation and promote physical, emotional and spiritual well-being.

reiki.question: How does a Reiki session work?
reiki.answer: During a session, the receiver remains clothed and lies down comfortably. The practitioner places their hands on or above the body to channel Reiki energy, release blockages and stimulate the natural healing process. The session takes place in a calm and secure setting, conducive to relaxation and energetic harmonization.

reiki.question: What are the benefits of Reiki?
reiki.answer: Reiki helps reduce stress, relieve tension and pain, improve sleep, release blocked emotions, strengthen the immune system and support emotional and spiritual balance.

reiki.question: Is Reiki religious?
reiki.answer: No, Reiki is not linked to any religion. It can be practiced and received by anyone, regardless of their beliefs or without any particular belief, focusing on its energetic and therapeutic effects.

reiki.question: Who can receive Reiki?
reiki.answer: Reiki is suitable for everyone, from infants to the elderly, including pregnant women and people who are ill. Its non-invasive and secure practice makes it an accessible treatment for most people.

reiki.question: How to become a Reiki practitioner?
reiki.answer: To become a practitioner, it is necessary to follow progressive training with initiations that allow you to open and channel energy, deepen personal practice and, for those who wish, learn to transmit this teaching. The practitioner must maintain a physical, energetic and spiritual lifestyle to maintain the clarity and effectiveness of their channel.

reiki.question: Can I learn Reiki with you?
reiki.answer: I am qualified to train and transmit Reiki initiations in a secure and caring environment, accompanying each person on their energetic and spiritual journey. For any request or interest regarding training and initiations, you can contact me at contact@coeurdelom.fr

reiki.question: Can Reiki replace medical treatments?
reiki.answer: Reiki complements conventional medical treatments to support healing and optimize results. It does not replace professional medical care and should not be used as the sole treatment for serious conditions.

chakras.question: What are chakras?
chakras.answer: Chakras are energy centers located along the spine, each corresponding to physical, emotional and spiritual aspects of the person. They regulate the circulation of vital energy and influence our overall balance.

chakras.question: How does Reiki act on the chakras?
chakras.answer: During a Reiki session, the practitioner channels energy on the chakras to dissolve blockages, harmonize the energy flow and restore balance. Each chakra can be stimulated or soothed according to individual needs, allowing gentle and deep reharmonization.

chakras.question: What are the benefits of chakra harmonization with Reiki?
chakras.answer:
• Emotional and mental balance
• Better circulation of vital energy
• Reduction of stress and tension
• Support for physical and spiritual well-being

chakras.question: Who can benefit from this practice?
chakras.answer: Everyone can receive chakra harmonization through Reiki. The session is adapted to each person and remains non-invasive and safe.

chakras.question: Sessions and support
chakras.answer: Chakra work is part of individual Reiki sessions at the office and can be integrated into regular follow-up to support overall energetic balance.

vibratory.title: Vibratory Healing
vibratory.description: Vibratory healing offers a holistic approach using sound, light and energy vibrations to balance body, mind and soul. Based on universal frequencies, these techniques—including singing bowls and mantras—reduce stress, improve sleep, relieve pain and increase energy. Each session is personalized to meet your specific needs, offering comprehensive support to improve health and well-being.

vibratory.question: What is vibratory therapy?
vibratory.answer: Vibratory therapy is a holistic approach that uses sound, light, energetic or specific frequency vibrations to harmonize body, mind and soul. It is based on the principle that everything in the universe vibrates and that these vibrations can support health, emotional balance and overall well-being.

vibratory.question: How does vibratory therapy work?
vibratory.answer: It works by stimulating the body's and mind's energies to restore harmony and promote natural energy circulation. This can be done through sound, singing, light, vibratory healing, color frequencies and guided meditations.

vibratory.question: What types of vibratory therapies do you offer?
vibratory.answer: I offer vibratory healing including sound therapy, crystalline and color frequencies, guided meditation and Reiki with chakra harmonization, all adapted to each person to support their vitality and inner balance.

vibratory.question: What are the benefits of vibratory therapy?
vibratory.answer: Vibratory healing can reduce stress and anxiety, improve sleep, relieve certain pains, stimulate vital energy, promote mental clarity and support the body's natural healing while strengthening emotional and spiritual balance.

vibratory.question: Who can benefit from vibratory healing?
vibratory.answer: These practices are accessible to all those who wish holistic support to relax, revitalize and reconnect with their inner essence, regardless of age or health status.

vibratory.question: Are there any contraindications?
vibratory.answer: Vibratory therapy is generally safe but may be discouraged for people with epileptic disorders, severe mental pathologies or high sensitivity to sensory stimulation. It is always recommended to consult a healthcare professional before starting.

bowls.question: What is crystal bowl therapy?
bowls.answer: Crystal bowl therapy is a vibratory approach I use, it exploits the sounds and harmonics of crystal singing bowls to harmonize the body, mind and energy centers, promoting relaxation, meditation and physical and emotional well-being.

bowls.question: How does this therapy work?
bowls.answer: The bowls emit vibrations at specific frequencies that resonate with different areas of the body and chakras, helping to release energy blockages, restore balance and support the natural circulation of energy.

bowls.question: What are the benefits of crystal bowl therapy?
bowls.answer: It can reduce stress and anxiety, improve sleep, relieve certain pains, stimulate vital energy, promote creativity, deep relaxation and support emotional and spiritual harmony.

bowls.question: How does a session take place?
bowls.answer: During the session, I make the crystal bowls resonate in a way adapted to your needs, you remain relaxed and receive the vibrations, promoting energetic harmonization and energy circulation.

bowls.question: Who can benefit from this therapy?
bowls.answer: Everyone can benefit from crystal bowls, especially those looking for a gentle and non-invasive approach to relax, revitalize or support their emotional and energetic balance.

bowls.question: Are there any contraindications?
bowls.answer: The practice is generally safe but may not be suitable for people with severe psychiatric disorders or high auditory sensitivity. It is recommended to consult a healthcare professional before starting if you have specific concerns.

tuningforks.question: What is a crystal tuning fork?
tuningforks.answer: The crystal tuning fork is an instrument made of pure quartz that emits a subtle and barely audible vibration, closer to a frequency than a traditional sound. This vibration promotes energetic harmonization and energy circulation in the body. Integrated into my traditional Chinese medicine practice, it supports and strengthens all the energy therapies I offer.

tuningforks.question: Why use them in my treatments?
tuningforks.answer: They are used to stimulate meridian points, harmonize energy flows and amplify the effectiveness of energy healing. Their subtle and almost imperceptible vibration acts deeply, framing and reinforcing all the techniques I apply.

tuningforks.question: How do I apply them?
tuningforks.answer: The tuning forks are applied on or near acupressure points, sometimes in combination with crystals or a styletto, to transmit the vibratory frequency and harmonize specific areas of the body.

tuningforks.question: What are the benefits?
tuningforks.answer: They harmonize meridians and vital energy, bring physical and emotional relaxation, support mental clarity and serenity, while strengthening the impact of other energy practices offered thanks to their subtle frequency.

tuningforks.question: Can everyone receive treatment with crystal tuning forks?
tuningforks.answer: Treatments are generally suitable for everyone, but certain contraindications may exist: people with a pacemaker, pregnant women in the first months, or any specific medical condition that requires medical advice. Each treatment is personalized and secured according to the client's energy profile and health.

meditation.title: Meditation
meditation.description: Meditation uses various techniques such as mindfulness, guided and transcendental meditation, as well as mantras like the OM sound, to promote relaxation, self-awareness and emotional healing. It reduces stress, anxiety and depression, improves concentration and mental clarity, and promotes inner peace.

meditation.question: What is the meditation I offer?
meditation.answer: The meditation I offer at Cœur de l'OM is a gentle yet powerful practice that invites you to reconnect with your inner center, calm the mind, and harmonize body and spirit. It draws on techniques such as chanting the OM mantra, heart-centered Dhyâna meditation, and other guided approaches to support emotional well-being, inner clarity, and harmonious energy flow

meditation.question: How does a meditation session work?
meditation.answer: The session takes place in a calm and safe space, where you are comfortably seated. I guide you through breathing exercises, guided meditations, mantra chanting, or visualizations, sometimes accompanied by bowls and vibratory sounds to enhance energetic resonance and inner experience. Depending on needs and requests, specific exercises also help develop concentration and calm the mind

meditation.question: What are the benefits of meditation?
meditation.answer: Meditation helps reduce stress, calm anxiety, and clarify the mind while promoting deep relaxation, emotional balance, and self-connection. It supports emotional regulation, improves concentration, brings a calmer mind, and a sense of serenity and inner harmony

meditation.question: Who can benefit from this meditation?
meditation.answer: Anyone wishing to reconnect with themselves, calm their mind, or support their emotional balance can benefit from this practice. It is suitable for everyone, beginners or experienced practitioners, and is practiced with respect for each person's rhythm and needs

meditation.question: Are there any contraindications?
meditation.answer: Meditation is generally safe for everyone, but may not be suitable for people with severe psychiatric disorders. It is recommended to consult a healthcare professional if you have specific concerns before starting

om.question: What is the OM mantra?
om.answer: The OM mantra is a sacred sound used for millennia in many spiritual traditions. It symbolizes universal harmony and the primordial vibration of life. Its resonance helps recenter the mind, balance energy, and nourish a deep connection to oneself

om.question: Why use the OM mantra during a treatment or meditation?
om.answer: Chanting OM harmonizes the body, mind, and vital energy. It creates a space of inner calm and openness and promotes fluid energy circulation. In my treatments, I use it with a crystal bowl specially tuned to the frequency of OM to amplify the vibration, support inner alignment, and strengthen the effect of the treatment

om.question: How is the OM mantra practiced?
om.answer: OM can be chanted aloud, whispered, or simply repeated mentally. Conscious breathing, regular rhythm, and focused intention allow you to feel its resonance unfold in the body and naturally enter a meditative state

om.question: What are the benefits of the OM mantra?
om.answer: OM calms the mind and relieves stress. It harmonizes the body's vibrations, supports inner clarity, and invites a state of presence. It also enhances the effectiveness of energy treatments, especially when its vibration is combined with the dedicated crystal bowl

om.question: Do I need to know its meaning to feel its effects?
om.answer: No, the most important thing is the experience of the vibration. It works even without intellectual understanding, and its benefits develop naturally with regular practice

om.question: Can I use it at home?
om.answer: Yes, OM can easily be integrated into your daily life. It can accompany a meditation, calming breathing, or be chanted simply to recenter and balance your energy

om.question: Where can I attend OM chanting and meditation sessions?
om.answer: You will find the dates and times of OM Chanting and meditation sessions in the site calendar, and you can register according to your availability

dhyana.question: What is Dhyâna meditation
dhyana.answer: Dhyâna meditation is a heart practice inspired by the Sufi tradition as transmitted by Irina Tweedie. It involves directing consciousness toward the vibration of the heart to transcend the flow of thoughts and access deep inner silence and subtle resonance of vital energy

dhyana.question: How is it integrated into my treatments
dhyana.answer: At Cœur de l'OM, Dhyâna meditation is an integral part of treatments and creates a space of calm and receptivity. The heart's vibration helps calm the mind, open sensitivity, and support energetic circulation throughout the body, thus strengthening the effect of other vibratory practices

dhyana.question: What are the benefits of Dhyâna meditation
dhyana.answer: The meditation promotes deep relaxation, letting go, and emotional balance. It awakens the heart's resonance, clarifies the mind, and improves concentration. It harmonizes and stimulates vital energy circulation and amplifies inner perception

dhyana.question: Who is this meditation for
dhyana.answer: Dhyâna meditation is accessible to everyone, beginners or experienced. Sessions are guided and adapted to each person's sensitivity, energetic profile, and emotional state

dhyana.question: How does a session work
dhyana.answer: The session begins with a moment of settling and relaxation in a comfortable posture. Consciousness is then directed toward the heart center, welcoming the silent inner vibration and energetic circulation. An integration time finally allows a gradual return to a state of full presence and awareness

dhyana.question: Public sessions and registration
dhyana.answer: Public sessions are offered at the center with a maximum of 8 participants to ensure personalized guidance and a secure setting. Dates are available in the center's calendar and advance registration is required

dhyana.question: Are there any contraindications or precautions
dhyana.answer: Dhyâna meditation is gentle and safe for most people. However, in case of particular mental or medical conditions, it is recommended to maintain medical follow-up and inform the practitioner. Each session is personalized and adjusted according to each person's needs and sensitivity

mantras.question: What is mantra chanting
mantras.answer: Mantra chanting is an ancient practice from the spiritual traditions of India and Buddhism that uses the repetition of sacred sounds or words to harmonize body, mind, and vital energy. The vibrations of mantras promote a state of deep relaxation, clarify the mind, and support emotional and spiritual healing

mantras.question: What are the benefits of mantra chanting
mantras.answer: Mantra chanting helps reduce stress and anxiety, improve concentration and mental clarity, stimulate vital energy, strengthen self-connection, and support inner transformation and heart peace

mantras.question: Is mantra chanting religious
mantras.answer: No, it can be practiced in a secular way and focus on the vibration and therapeutic effects of sound regardless of any religious belief

mantras.question: Who can benefit from it
mantras.answer: Anyone seeking a gentle, energetic, and meditative practice can benefit. It is particularly suitable for those who wish to calm the mind, strengthen their inner centering, and awaken their consciousness

mantras.question: Public sessions and registration
mantras.answer: Sessions are offered at the center with a limited number of participants to ensure quality support. Dates are available in the center's calendar and advance registration is recommended

mantras.question: Are there any contraindications
mantras.answer: The practice is generally safe but may not be suitable for people with vocal disorders or particular auditory sensitivity. If in doubt, it is advisable to consult a healthcare professional before participating

chromobio.title: ChromoBioEnergy
chromobio.description: ChromoBioEnergy uses color as mysterious music to reharmonize our body and mind. Each person is born with a unique capital of colors, and this method, adapted to individual needs, treats various imbalances. Thanks to the chromoemotional tests developed by Evelyne Monsallier, the dissonances of your inner melody are detected and corrected.

chromobio.question: What is ChromoBioEnergy?
chromobio.answer: ChromoBioEnergy is a holistic approach that uses colors, vibrations, and frequencies to harmonize vital energy, support emotional balance, and strengthen overall well-being.

chromobio.question: How does this therapy work in my treatments?
chromobio.answer: I begin by assessing the client's energetic profile, then use adapted protocols combining colors, crystals, and vibrations to restore harmony in energy flows and support the other therapies I offer.

chromobio.question: Can we do a time-limited test?
chromobio.answer: Yes, it is possible to perform a quick and limited test on my site, which provides a general overview of the energetic profile with some explanations. This test does not replace the complete therapy or in-depth analysis of colors and essences.

chromobio.question: How does the complete therapy work?
chromobio.answer: The complete therapy includes a personalized blend of color essences, designed in the same way as floral harmonizers, to act deeply on energetic balance and support each person's specific needs. For this complete approach, it is necessary to contact me to arrange a personalized session.

chromobio.question: What are the possible benefits?
chromobio.answer:
• Harmonization of body energies and meridians
• Emotional and mental support
• Better vital energy circulation
• Amplification of the effectiveness of other energy practices

chromobio.question: Can everyone receive this treatment?
chromobio.answer: ChromoBioEnergy is suitable for most people. Treatments are personalized and adjusted according to each client's sensitivity, energetic profile, and health status.

tambour.title: Shamanic Drum
tambour.description: The shamanic drum technique, inspired by ancient traditions, uses repetitive rhythms to induce an altered state of consciousness conducive to healing and self-exploration. This practice promotes connection with spirits, nature, and the inner self, helping to relieve stress, anxiety, and depression, while stimulating creativity and self-awareness. Accessible to all, this holistic therapy guides participants on an inner journey through drum sounds, accompanied by visualizations and meditations.

tambour.question: What is the shamanic drum?
tambour.answer: The shamanic drum is a vibratory and sound tool used in shamanism to support inner exploration, relaxation, and energetic rebalancing. The regular rhythm of the drum promotes a deep meditative state, allowing body and mind to relax, recenter, and reconnect with their own inner resources

tambour.question: How does a shamanic drum session work?
tambour.answer: The session takes place in a calm and secure space where you are comfortably seated. I play the drum according to a specific rhythm that guides listening and relaxation, sometimes associated with visualizations or conscious breathing. The experience can be individual or collective and is adapted to each person to promote letting go and energetic harmonization

tambour.question: What are the benefits of the shamanic drum?
tambour.answer: The shamanic drum helps calm the mind, reduce stress, release tensions, and promote a sense of centering and serenity. It also supports vital energy circulation, strengthens concentration, and opens an inner space conducive to intuition, creativity, and reconnection with oneself

tambour.question: Who can benefit from a shamanic drum session?
tambour.answer: Anyone wishing to relax, recenter, explore their inner world, or support their energetic balance can benefit from a session. It is suitable for beginners as well as regular practitioners, and each session is adjusted to each person's rhythm and needs

tambour.question: Are there any contraindications?
tambour.answer: The shamanic drum is generally safe, but may not be suitable for people with severe psychiatric disorders or certain cardiac conditions sensitive to sound vibrations. It is recommended to consult a healthcare professional if you have specific concerns before participating in a session

amma.title: Amma Massage
amma.description:
Amma massage, based on traditional Chinese medicine, balances the body's energies through pressures, stretches and percussions along the meridians. It reduces stress, relaxes muscles, improves circulation, relieves pain, stimulates the immune system and increases overall energy.
30-minute sessions, performed on an ergonomic chair, are accessible to everyone, except for pregnant women and certain medical conditions. For lasting results, regular sessions are recommended and can be combined with other treatments.

amma.question: What is Amma massage?
amma.answer: Amma massage is a technique of Chinese origin that acts on the body's energy meridians through targeted pressures, stretches and percussions to restore energy balance, promote relaxation and release tensions

amma.question: What are the benefits of Amma massage?
amma.answer: Amma massage helps reduce stress and anxiety, relaxes muscles, improves blood and lymphatic circulation, relieves muscle and joint pain, stimulates the immune system and restores vitality and overall energy

amma.question: How does an Amma massage session work?
amma.answer: The session begins with an exchange to identify your needs, you are then seated on an ergonomic chair and I perform pressures, tapping and stretches on the back, shoulders, arms and hands. The session generally lasts 30 minutes and it is important to remain relaxed and attentive to sensations

amma.question: Is Amma massage painful?
amma.answer: Amma massage is designed to be comfortable, but there may be slight discomfort on very tense areas. The rhythm and pressure are always adapted to your feelings so that the experience is pleasant and beneficial

amma.question: Are there any contraindications?
amma.answer: Amma massage is safe for most people, but it is not recommended for pregnant women, people with recent injuries, infectious diseases, serious heart problems or medical conditions requiring special attention

amma.question: How to prepare for an Amma massage session?
amma.answer: No specific preparation is necessary, just wear comfortable clothes and report any medical condition or area of tension you wish to work on

amma.question: How many sessions are needed to feel the effects?
amma.answer: Effects can be felt from the first session, but regular sessions allow for lasting and deep results, adapted to your needs and goals

amma.question: Can Amma massage be combined with other treatments?
amma.answer: Yes, Amma massage combines easily with other natural or therapeutic approaches to enhance effects and support overall well-being

fengshui.title: Energetic Feng Shui
fengshui.description: Energetic Feng Shui goes beyond simple space arrangement to analyze and harmonize the energy flows of a place. As an Alpha Chi Consultant, I apply the Eickermann method to create an environment conducive to well-being, vitality, and balance, taking into account the natural and subtle forces that influence the energy of your living or working space.

fengshui.question: What is energetic Feng Shui?
fengshui.answer: Energetic Feng Shui goes beyond simple space arrangement and aims to analyze and harmonize the energy flows of a place to create an environment favorable to well-being, vitality, and balance by taking into account the natural and subtle forces that influence the energy of a space

fengshui.question: How does this method work?
fengshui.answer: According to the Eickermann method and as an Alpha Chi Consultant, I observe the energetic resonance of a place, detect disturbed areas, and strengthen favorable energies in order to restore the natural order of flows and allow the space to fully support its inhabitants in their daily life and inner path

fengshui.question: What does this method offer?
fengshui.answer: I offer a personalized energetic analysis of your living or working space, harmonization of energy flows through subtle techniques respectful of the place, and practical advice to maintain and support energetic balance in your daily life

fengshui.question: What are the possible benefits?
fengshui.answer: This approach promotes a feeling of peace and harmony in your space, improves vital energy circulation, supports physical, mental and emotional well-being, and creates an environment conducive to inner clarity and serenity

fengshui.question: Is this method spiritual?
fengshui.answer: It is based on a fine perception of energies and subtle principles while remaining accessible to all those who wish to improve the harmony and vitality of their environment

fengshui.question: Can I apply it at home?
fengshui.answer: Some simple practices can be implemented by everyone but for precise and complete support it is recommended to consult a trained practitioner to benefit from harmonization adapted to your place and your personal energy

chromobioPretest.title: Chromobio Test
chromobioPretest.description: Discover our quick Chromobioenergetics test, an online tool that allows you to get a general overview of your energetic profile. Accessible once a month, it highlights your color spectrum and indicates for each shade its vitality level, thus revealing excesses, deficits or absences in your energy.
chromobioPretest.description2: This test offers a first reading of your energies and does not replace an in-depth analysis or a complete rebalancing session. After the test, personalized guidance allows you to interpret your results and define a custom blend of color essences, designed as floral harmonizers to support balance, energy circulation and the harmony of your "inner music".
